cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Apologize Properly
cards.instruction: Get someone to deliver the apology in the form, order, and setting you consider valid.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Please apologise for eating my cake at the table where it happened. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry. Does that help?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. It's a promising rehearsal. The cake plate is over there.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your dad's sitting there. Can't we do this privately?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: He watched me blame the dog. Tell him you ate it before you tell me you're sorry.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twelve was the consultation time. Eleven is my decision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll announce that before anyone else does.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm captain of this rowing team. Everybody rows on my whistle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We prefer counting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll whistle the numbers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A captain adapts. You'll still call me captain?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please apologise for eating my cake at the table where it happened.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry. Does that help?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It's a promising rehearsal. The cake plate is over there.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your dad's sitting there. Can't we do this privately?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: He watched me blame the dog. Tell him you ate it before you tell me you're sorry.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your apology email needs a subject line mentioning the broken vase.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wrote 'sorry.'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For all I know, that's about your choice of font.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll send 'Sorry about the vase' to Mum. She still thinks you broke it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start with 'I broke it.' My name comes out of the story before your apology goes in.

cards.title: Get It on the Record
cards.instruction: Get formal approval, endorsement, or acknowledgment before anyone can quietly revise their position.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. You've approved the festival budget. Will you initial that before lunch? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I just said yes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. You said yes to the fireworks last year too.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: And I changed my mind.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. This year I'd like a dated yes to change from.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twelve was the consultation time. Eleven is my decision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll announce that before anyone else does.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm captain of this rowing team. Everybody rows on my whistle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We prefer counting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll whistle the numbers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A captain adapts. You'll still call me captain?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've approved the festival budget. Will you initial that before lunch?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I just said yes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You said yes to the fireworks last year too.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: And I changed my mind.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. This year I'd like a dated yes to change from.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I pay the builder, will you sign that my fence can stay on our boundary?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I suppose it can.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you put 'can stay' beside your name? The builder won't invoice 'suppose.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't want to promise forever.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Date it today, then. If you change your mind, we'll know which permission changed.

cards.title: Borrowed Authority

cards.title: Assigned by Procedure
cards.instruction: Get someone to accept an unwanted responsibility by proving that the rules, rotation, or tradition make it theirs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. It's your bin night. The rota puts you on Tuesdays. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I took yours last week.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. And I took your Thursday. The swap box says 'one week only.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You added that box.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At your request, so I couldn't keep your easy Thursday. It protects your Tuesday too.

beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twelve was the consultation time. Eleven is my decision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll announce that before anyone else does.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm captain of this rowing team. Everybody rows on my whistle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We prefer counting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll whistle the numbers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A captain adapts. You'll still call me captain?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Congratulations on becoming club president. Here are the toilet keys.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought the caretaker cleaned them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We voted to save that fee. The minutes assign closing and cleaning to the president.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I proposed that when you were president.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, and I cleaned them all year. Your first presidential duty is continuing your savings.

cards.title: Complete the Record
cards.instruction: Get someone to fill the missing gaps in an account without revealing which answer matters most to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. For the party report, what time did you arrive, leave, and visit the kitchen? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why specifically the kitchen?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. It's the only room missing from the timeline.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cake disappeared then.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll give the cake its own line. First, your kitchen time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twelve was the consultation time. Eleven is my decision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll announce that before anyone else does.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm captain of this rowing team. Everybody rows on my whistle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We prefer counting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll whistle the numbers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A captain adapts. You'll still call me captain?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For the party report, what time did you arrive, leave, and visit the kitchen?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why specifically the kitchen?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It's the only room missing from the timeline.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cake disappeared then.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll give the cake its own line. First, your kitchen time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm filling the shared car log. What were the mileage, fuel level and driver after nine?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You mean who dented it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I mean all three blanks. Start with mileage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Driver I remember. The rest means going down six flights to the glovebox.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll fetch the book and bring you tea on the way back. Then you can give me the whole row in order.

cards.title: Borrowed Authority

cards.title: Make It Official
cards.instruction: Recruit someone by giving them a title, role, or ceremonial duty that makes participation feel binding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I've made you Keeper of the Festival Lantern. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only said I'd hold it while you tied your shoe.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. An excellent probationary performance. Here's your badge.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How long is the appointment?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Until you find a qualified successor. The lantern must never be abandoned.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As your new shift leader, I'm moving lunch to twelve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The crew eats at eleven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Twelve was the consultation time. Eleven is my decision.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We also leave early on Fridays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I'll announce that before anyone else does.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm captain of this rowing team. Everybody rows on my whistle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We prefer counting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll whistle the numbers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just count?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. A captain adapts. You'll still call me captain?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've made you Keeper of the Festival Lantern.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only said I'd hold it while you tied your shoe.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An excellent probationary performance. Here's your badge.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How long is the appointment?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Until you find a qualified successor. The lantern must never be abandoned.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Would you be honorary patron of our roof appeal? You'd open it and thank the donors.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can come, but I won't make a speech.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then accept the patron's ribbon and lead the applause. That can be your ceremonial duty.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I leave after the first donation?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The patron applauds every donor. We couldn't have the later ones thinking their money mattered less.
